decisions.reason: Selecting Garamond does not necessarily change the whitespace-balancing requirement. The same message's separate decisions about Fun Fact images and future word counts are already represented by the candidate's existing MODIFY.
The body-typeface selection does not change author names, photographs, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
Selecting the article body typeface does not change the requirement to break up long text with images, blurbs, or quotes.
Garamond is selected specifically for article body typography; the source does not modify the broader polished, modern, brand-aligned style or red-color rule.
The body-font decision does not change the requirement that advertisements render clearly. The backup advertisements mentioned in the same message are a separate matter.
Selecting Garamond does not alter the digital flipbook deliverable or its balanced two-page-spread behavior.
The body-typeface selection does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
The body-font selection does not modify the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The source notes time pressure but does not change the existing digital launch target or deadline.
